sections.text_helper: Section 37.3.1 "Hardware settings" in chapter 37 (Camera subsystem), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1784.
sections.section_content:
The camera subsystem is implemented with the following specific settings:
• CSI2: two data lanes (+ one clock lane) up to 2.5 Gbps/lane.
• DCMIPP FIFO: 5 Kbytes for AXI
• DCMIPP with the following subfeatures:
– line-buffers: 2688 pixels (impacts the demosaicing, downsize,
YUV420conversion)
– one dump pipe + two pixel pipes (pipe1 with YUV420/multi-planar only)
